name: Festival of Arts and Crafts

raw: Festival of Arts and Crafts, Fri Nov 27 - Sun Nov 29 2026, Lake County Fairgrounds, 305 crafters from 11 states, free parking, $5 admission (children 11 and under are free). notes: Indoor hand-crafted-only craft show; free parking. 2026 date from Visit Lake County listing (host page lists 2027 shows).
